payload.summary: On Call: a failed load looks like an empty hub, or says 'You are offline' when the server errored
payload.detail: entry-store.ts sets isOffline on any fetch failure; with no cache the banner needs cachedAt so it is hidden and pages show 'No contacts yet'/'Your On Call hub is empty'. With a cache a 500 says 'You are offline'. No retry on section pages.
payload.source: On Call + CME audit 2026-09-24 (code read + demo-mode screenshots, branch claude/on-call-cme-audit-gltczi)
